email.body:
Hi {{ contact.first_name }},

Your tone for {{ custom_values.anthology_name }} is ready.

You can view the PDF here:
{{contact.anthology_tone_pdf_url}}

And you can edit your Google Doc here:
{{contact.anthology_tone_doc_url}}

The PDF is yours to view. The Google Doc is the one you edit, and it is the version we use.

If you are happy with it, you can move to the next step by opening this link:
https://link.msgsndr.com/widget/form/<form_id>?anthology_id={{ contact.anthology_id }}&stage=s2_gate

Thank you for being part of {{ custom_values.anthology_name }}.

Warmly,
The Editors
